slides.sub: Cortisol running the show. Fat holds under load.

posts.sub_1: Bloating, 3pm crashes, stalled fat loss, flat mornings - none of it is random. It is a read, if you know how to take it.
Then comes the part that compounds - holding the correction for the long arc. More on that soon.
